result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero quantity. The change is one filter in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse`, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`:

- The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the stock-per-category, per-category-and-warehouse and slow-moving overviews already use.
- `findStockQuantity` is unchanged, so asking for the quantity of an empty product still returns 0.

`StockOverviewTest`, `StockServiceTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass offline (`mvn -q -o test`, exit 0). I did not add a regression test for the zero-quantity case, and nothing was committed.
